description: The top of the cluster: fixture row 49 of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt, the last and highest of the fifty keys - 9805583408996588 / 000000040 / 00000000040 - seeded alone, so the browse opens, returns that one record, and then reports end of file. app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl:30-32 declares ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED with ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL over RECORD KEY FD-XREF-CARD-NUM, so the READ at :93 delivers the highest key and the next one takes the '10' arm at :98, moves 16 into APPL-RESULT at :99, satisfies the 88 APPL-EOF condition at :107 and moves 'Y' to END-OF-FILE at :108, ending the PERFORM UNTIL at :74 with no error line and no abend. Paired with case03, which seeds row 0 alone, this says that a record's POSITION in the cluster changes nothing about how it is displayed: both runs emit four lines and in both the image is the row's own bytes. Four lines is 2 + (2 x 1) derived mechanically, not counted: the two banners at :71 and :85, and two displays per record because each record is written once at :96 inside 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT and again at :78 in the mainline. RETURN-CODE is 0 because nothing is ever moved to it anywhere in the program's 178 lines and :87 GOBACK returns zero. Nothing is written: :120 opens INPUT and the program contains no WRITE, no REWRITE and no DELETE, so the final state is the seeded row unchanged - which is the assertion that keeps the prompt-mandated name AccountBalanceUpdateJob honest about a program that updates nothing. The fifty-byte image is derived from app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy, which declares XREF-CARD-NUM X(16) + XREF-CUST-ID 9(09) + XREF-ACCT-ID 9(11) + FILLER X(14) = 50, and the four field expectations say where each byte belongs - 0 to 15, 16 to 24, 25 to 35 and 36 to 49 - so an off-by-one is reported against the field it corrupted. The shipped row measures 36 because the FILLER span is absent from the data, so this case declares CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 and those fourteen spaces are supplied exactly once, at seed time, by the single owner of that pad. This case arranges no I/O failure and runs clean: the failed OPEN, the failed READs and the failed CLOSE are pinned by case06 through case13, so an error line or a non-zero return code added here would duplicate case06 rather than pin anything new. Statically derived, never captured - every expected value above was read out of app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl, app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy, app/jcl/READXREF.jcl (a bare EXEC PGM=CBACT03C with no PARM, which is why no job parameter is declared) and app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt, because executing the legacy program is empirically impossible in this environment (AAP risk R-A).
